item.title: Bhubaneswar: Fire breaks out at Unit-I Haat; over 40 shops gutted
item.description: Bhubaneswar: Over 40 shops were gutted, and goods worth lakhs of rupees were destroyed in a major fire at Unit-I Haat in Bhubaneswar early Tuesday, police said.
